findings.message: 6 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "2027 Edition · Only 500 boxes" above "BARA MASA"; "Sound familiar?" above "For everyone who misses Odisha without s"; "Inside the box" above "12 months. 13 festivals."; "Stories" above "Last year, 2,000+ people loved it."; "From the creators" above "Hear it from the creators."
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 7 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "2027 Edition · Only 500 boxes", "Sound familiar?", "Inside the box", "Stories").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 92 gradient fill(s): div.absolute.inset-0 → radial-gradient(75% 55% at 50% 68%, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.14) 0%, rgba(224, 165, 38, 0.07) 45%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0 | div.absolute.inset-0 → radial-gradient(rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 40%, rgba(138, 23, 23, 0.035) 75%, rgba(70, 25, 10, 0.08) 100%) | div.absolute.inset-x-0 → linear-gradient(oklab(0 0 0 / 0.85) 0%, oklab(0 0 0 / 0.4) 50%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 100%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 102 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: button.group.relative → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | a.mt-6.flex → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | div.-rotate-1.sm:-rotate-2 → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 7 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.self-start.border-b 584px | div.self-start.border-b 584px | div.self-start.border-b 584px | div.self-start.border-b 584px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.
One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: 2 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "12 months. 13 festivals." (screen 4, 50% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.
